text: After a severe storm in Bridgton, Maine, artist David Drayton and his young son Billy are in the supermarket when [a thick mist swallows the town|images|weather, sky and darkness], hiding [tentacled things, giant insects and spider-like creatures|threat|monsters and creatures]. Behind the barricaded windows, the religious fanatic Mrs. Carmody preaches divine punishment and gathers followers who [call for sacrifices to appease the monsters|wants|the sacrifice demanded]. A soldier reveals that [a military experiment to find other dimensions went wrong|origin|monsters people made].
